raw_text: So check this out if you've ever wondered whether large language models are actually 'thinking' the way we do. raw_text: So check this out—we always hear that bigger AI models win everything, right? Well, MIT researchers just pushed back on that with a method called SLIC for analog chip design. Here's the wild part: it still delivered performance comparable to much bigger models, while cutting down the heavy compute costs and complexity.
